en.bdb: Benefaction of mother and maltreatment of son) ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੁਤੈ ਦੀ ਕੁੜਮਾਈ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: maataa pitaa ana(n)dh vich putai dhee kuRamaiee hoiee|

en.bdb: Parents are happy that the betrothel ceremony of their son has been solemnized.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਸੀ ਅੰਗ ਨ ਮਾਵਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: rahasee a(n)g na maaviee gaavai sohilaRe sukh hoiee|

en.bdb: Mother becomes overjoyed and sings songs of happiness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਗਸੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਆਹਿਐ ਘੋੜੀ ਲਾਵਾਂ ਗਾਵ ਭਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: vigasee putr viaahiaai ghoRee laavaa(n) gaav bhaloiee|

en.bdb: Singing eulogies of bridegroom, and praying for the welfare of the couple she feels very happy that her son got married.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਾਂ ਸੁਖੈ ਮਾਵੜੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਨੂੰਹ ਦਾ ਮੇਲ ਅਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: sukhaa(n) sukhai maavaRee put noo(n)h dhaa mel aloiee|

en.bdb: For the well-being and harmony of bride and bridegroom the mother makes vows of offerings (before the deities).

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੁਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਕੰਤ ਕੁਮੰਤੁ ਦੇਇ ਵਿਹਰੇ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਸਸੁ ਵਿਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: nuh nit ka(n)t kuma(n)t dhei vihare hovan sas vigoiee|

en.bdb: Now, the bride starts ill-advising the son, goading him to get separate from the parents, and consequently the mother-in-law becomes sorrowful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਕੁਪੁਤਿ ਚਕੀ ਉਠਿ ਝੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh upakaar visaar kai put kuput chakee uTh jhoiee|

en.bdb: Forgetting lacs of benefactions (of mother) the son becomes disloyal and sets himself at logger-heads with his parents.
Rare is any obdient son like Sravan of mythology who was most obedient to his blind parents.
